title: Some people will not be able to use this in their car if a grounded power outlet is more than 17 feet away
text:
Some people will not be able to use this in their car if a grounded power outlet is more than 17 feet away. I am no stranger to carpet cleaners (shampooers). I own a [[ASIN:B0045I8E4M Hoover MaxExtract77 Multi-Surface Pro Carpet & Hard Floor Cleaner FH50240]] and an older version of the [[ASIN:B00450U7QS BISSELL Spotbot Pet Handsfree Spot and Stain Cleaner with Deep Reach Technology, 33N8]]. I also purchased for my boyfriend and have used myself the [[ASIN:B000ASDCWK BISSELL ProHeat 2X Select Upright Deep Carpet Cleaner, 9400M]]. In general, I found Bissell cleaners to be more than satisfactory with the exception of the [[ASIN:B001EYILAW BISSELL PROdry Fast-Drying Carpet Cleaner, 7350]] which I threw out because it was that bad.

For this auto cleaner, I listed the PROS and CONS below and found the unit to be only satisfactory for my purposes.

PROS:

- This can be used for the home or auto.

- Assembly is easy; just attach the hardware (one clip and one arm) for the hose and the brush and you are set.

- It comes with a small bottle of 2x Little Green for Compacts solution.

- The solution has a nice, yet subtle fresh scent.

- The solution tank is easy to fill and the dirty water tank is easy to rinse out. Be careful when inserting the solution tank back into the unit because when I turned the tank over, I held the tank a little too tight which caused the solution to start squirting out. Once I changed my hold to be more subtle and on the upper part of the tank, this squirting ceased.

- The built in heater took only 25 seconds to heat up as opposed to the 30 seconds mentioned in the manual. I also found that the water does come out "warmer" than the other cleaners I have.

- A two-in-one crevice tool is supplied which can be converted with the flip of a switch from a small tiny brush to just a crevice tool that I assume can be used to soak up a puddle of water (although the manual does not say).

- The cord is relatively long for a compact unit which I measured to be around 20 feet; that's about 19-1/2 feet of useable extension. (See the CONS with regard to the cord, which is why I could not use this in my auto.)

- The unit has a quick-release cord wrap which enabled me to unravel the cord easily.

- The solution is easy to dispense and is dispensed out in a fan pattern over the stain. The further away from the surface of the carpet you hold your brush while dispensing the solution the larger the area it covers.

- Although the unit does not pick up as much water as my Spotbot does, I still felt that it picked up enough.

- I thought it spot cleaned my house carpet as well as any of my other cleaners. For my type stains, which are usually cat vomit, that means it lightened the stain. As a result, I suspect it would be great on upholstery and auto interiors such as floor mats, seats, etc. (although I wouldn't use it on the headliner--that's the material on the underside of the roof).

- I was able to clean my removable car floor mat by bringing it into my house for cleaning. It was black in spots and it came out almost spotless although I did use a lot of elbow grease when working the brush over the mat. In fact the dirty water was pitch black when I was done.

- The crevice tool (with the tiny brush) and the small brush that comes with the unit means that this is mostly for spot cleaning; however, with enough back and forth over the affected area, you could clean as much as you wanted.
- Customer service is available Mon to Fri 8 am -10 pm and Saturday 9 a.m. to 8 p.m. Eastern Time.

- I called them twice around 9 p.m. Eastern Time to clarify the WARNINGs in the manual and both reps gave me the same answer which you'll read about in the CONS.

- The unit comes with a 1-year limited warranty.

CONS:

- Only those who have a garage or access to a grounded power outlet within about 17 feet of their car would be able to use this. I said 17 feet because you do need some slack to get into the car even though the hose will extend some. I was unable to clean my car with this because the power cord was not long enough to reach and using an extension cord might cause a severe electrical shock or (as the reps on the phone told me) blow out the circuit breakers in my house. I made sure to call Bissell twice and ask if I could use a cord rated higher than the unit and they said no. I did not ask if this could be used with a jumpstart or other battery pack with an AC connection, although that might be an option, but I would caution you to check first. I live on the 2nd floor and my boyfriend does too, so neither one of us could use this in the car because the WARNING in the manual reads:

WARNING: Do not use an extension cord with the product. The use of an extension cord may result in a severe electrical shock, particularly if the extension cord does not have an electrical rating higher than that of the product, OR if the extension cord does not have a three-prong grounding plug and if the extension cord is not plugged into a circuit box with a ground fault circuit interrupter. Safety precautions such as keeping all connections off the ground and dry will not eliminate the danger.

- I do not like that I can only use the Bissell 2x Little Green for Compacts formula in this unit. This means I cannot use any other Bissell cleaning products in this unit and I called customer service to verify this. The WARNING in the manual reads:

WARNING: Use only BISSELL Little Green formula in your cleaner. Use of cleaning formulas which contain lemon or pine oil may damage this appliance and void the warranty. Chemical spot cleaners or solvent-based soil removers also should not be used. These products may react with the plastic materials used in your cleaner, causing cracking or pitting.

- The user instructions are not so good. For instance, nowhere does it mention that both the built in heater and the unit has to be in the on position to heat up the water; although that is intuitive. Also, the manual should say you should vacuum first before using. I already know this but not everyone would.

- A bit of water stays behind in the channel below the dirty water tank and in the tough stain tool which is expected; however, be careful if moving this around or transporting to another location because if the unit tilts the dirty water that remains in the channel might spill out.

In summary, I selected this product so that I could clean the attached carpet in my auto and the cloth seats in my boyfriend's auto, but was unable to do that due to the extension cord restriction. However, I still feel this is a satisfactory carpet cleaner / shampooer that can be used to spot clean carpet or upholstery in my home or the removable dirty floor mats that I can bring in from the car. As long as one has access to an outlet close to their car, based on the results in my home and on my removable vehicle floor mats I have no doubt this would work on cloth car seats and the non-removable auto carpet. I do wish I could use another Bissell cleaning solution (such as the pet solution) besides the one that came with the unit; but that did not take away from the cleaning power; it just takes away from the options. In essence this unit has only one cleaning option, the Bissell 2x Little Green for Compacts formula.

I feel this unit was 2.5 stars because of the limited options and rounded up to give it 3 stars. If the first two CONS were addressed, then I probably would have rated this four stars as it does clean as well as the three other units (including the Hoover) that I listed in my introduction. Nevertheless, as a potential buyer, only you can try to determine based on the the various posted reviews if this unit is right for you.

product_metadata.title: Bissell Auto Care ProHeat Compact Multi-Purpose Deep Cleaner, 14254
features: Compact multi-purpose wet vacuum delivers thorough deep cleaning
Powerful spray and suction clean and help dry in one step
Built-in hot-water heater for enhanced results; separate clean/dirty water tanks
Flexible hose, tough-stain brush, spraying crevice tool, and cleaning formula included
Measures 8-1/5 by 17-1/5 by 12-1/2 inches; 1-year limited warranty
description: A powerful mini steam-vac, this compact multi-purpose deep cleaner uses hot water and a cleaning agent to eliminate both deep-down dirt and surface spills. Designed especially for cleaning vehicle interiors, it also works great on carpeting, stairs, and upholstery in the home. The unit's built-in hot-water heater raises the temperature of tap water by 25 degrees F for enhanced results, while its strong spray and suction remove tough spots and stains, plus help dry, all in one step. The machine provides a 5-foot upholstery hose and two handy attachments: a 3-inch tough-stain brush and a two-in-one spraying crevice tool. Clean, soapy water stores in a solution tank on one side, and used, dirty water gets recovered into a separate collection tank on the other side. The tanks remove for easy filling, and the machine can be stored ready to use. Other details include a 9 amp motor, a 3- to 5-inch cleaning path, PCV-free parts, a 15-foot power cord, and quick-release cord-storage hooks. An 8-ounce bottle of Little Green cleaning solution comes included. The multi-purpose deep cleaner measures 8-1/5 by 17-1/5 by 12-1/2 inches and carries a one-year limited warranty.
